---
title: "Presidential Approval Ratings"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 18
#| fig-width: 10

library(tidyverse)

# Load monthly approval data and order presidents chronologically
monthly_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = fct_reorder(president, year_month, .fun = min))

# Separate panel for each president tracking monthly approval
ggplot(monthly_data, aes(x = year_month, y = approval, color = party)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Democrat" = "#2E74C0", "Republican" = "#CB454A")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(20, 95, by = 5),
    labels = \(y) paste0(y, "%"),
    limits = c(20, 95)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  facet_wrap(~president, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Presidential Approval Rating by Month (1945–2025)",
    subtitle = "Monthly Gallup approval rating by president; dashed line marks 50% benchmark",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Approval Rating",
    color = "Party",
    caption = "Source: Gallup Polls via DataCamp & American Presidency Project"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```
